## History

Charlotta the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) served as the young helper and maid to Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). She voiced concern to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Miss Lavendar's unusual despondency, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to offer her support. Later, Charlotta expressed excitement about moving to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) amidst preparations for Miss Lavendar's wedding, and after the ceremony, she joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in tidying up [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) once the newlyweds departed.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), +10 more_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlotta--lavendar-lewis.md)

Charlotta serves as the young helper and handmaiden to Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). She assists Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) with hosting guests for imaginary tea parties, setting the table, and demonstrating the lodge's unique echoes. Charlotta shows deep concern for her mistress's emotional well-being, confiding in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) suffers from unusual despondency and apathy. After helping prepare for Miss Lavendar's eventual wedding, Charlotta works alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tidy up [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) following the ceremony.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), +21 more_

- Serves under — mistress to handmaiden  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), +1 more</sub>
